text:
ana: Following up on the ETL aggregation regressions we saw this week. There's a repeating pattern where late-arriving spans with null service_name cause group-by miscounts and silent aggregation. Need owners + timeline.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-210 filed (P3) - Observability aggregation mismatch. Details: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-210
kevin: can someone paste the problematic SQL or reduce repro?
mike: snippet: `INSERT INTO agg_daily SELECT service_name, count(*) FROM spans WHERE service_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY service_name;` Problem: late spans inserted with empty string for service_name cause undercounting in some downstream joins.
ana: (typo) ana: I will take ownership of adding normalization step to the ETL and a nightly assert comparing raw vs agg totals. ETA: 4 days.
data-eng: will prepare a backfill plan, recommend running backfill per-shard to limit lock contention. ETA: 6 days for scheduling.
kevin: I'll add monitoring: delta between raw span count and agg_total > 0.2% over 1h alert. ETA 48h.
ana: action items:
- ana - ETL normalization + nightly assert (ETA 4d)
- data-eng - backfill plan & execution (ETA 6d)
- kevin - metric + alert + dashboard (ETA 48h)
- mike - add regression test in integration suite to inject empty service_name and verify counts (ETA 3d)
ops-bot: INC-2026-210 owners set: ana (lead), data-eng (backfill), kevin (monitoring)
kevin: I'll add the remediation cards and link to this thread.
ana: sync Friday 11am PT to confirm backfill window.
kevin: :thumbsup:
